items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: And I worked with Henry Rush with Kit Thomas.

ctx.x: Was he any kind to Willie Kaifer? Did you ever know Willie Kaifer? I don't know Willie Kaifer. He was a musician? Yeah. He was a trumpet player and Henry Rush was telling me about him.
Yeah, well that's another guy. Yeah. And I worked with Henry Rush with Kit Thomas. Oh yeah? Yeah.
When were you working with Thomas? That was way early in your career? Yeah, it was kind of early in my career. You never worked in his band in later years?
